effect_description_eng:
While you have no face-up security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] All of your level 4 or highter Digimon with the [NSo] trait gain ＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon with the [NSo] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
